results.question: How much oil did well F-12 (15/9-F-12) of the Volve field in the Norwegian North Sea produce in 2011, in standard cubic metres? Give your best number.
results.answer:
I don't have a verified 2011 annual production volume for Volve well 15/9-F-12 in standard cubic metres in my memory, and I will not guess a number.

You can get the official figure from:

* Norwegian Offshore Directorate - FactPages / NPD FactMaps - production data per well, reported monthly in Sm3 - search for field "Volve" 15/9 and wellbore 15/9-F-12
* The Equinor Volve open dataset released in 2018, which contains daily/monthly production volumes including `15_9-F-12` - see the production files in the Volve Data Village

If you pull the monthly oil volumes for 01.01.2011 to 31.12.2011 for that wellbore and sum them you will get the annual total in Sm3.

results.question: When did the Volve field stop producing, and how much oil did it produce in total?
results.data_says: shut down in September 2016; about 10 million Sm3 (63 million barrels)
results.answer:
The Volve Field in the Norwegian North Sea — Block 15/9 — stopped producing in **September 2016**.

* **First oil:** February 2008
* **Shutdown / cessation of production:** 15 September 2016, after just over 8 years on production, operated at the time by Statoil, now Equinor. The field was then decommissioned in 2017-2018, and Equinor subsequently released the full subsurface and production dataset as open data.

* **Total production:** Approximately **10 million Sm3 of oil**, equivalent to about **62-63 million barrels**.

That was well above the original estimate at plan for development and included the Maureen Formation. In addition the field produced about 2-3 billion Sm3 of gas/gas liquids during the same period.

All figures are reported by the Norwegian Petroleum Directorate, NPD, and Equinor. Reported totals vary slightly by source due to rounding and whether condensate/NGL are included, but 63 million bbl / 10 million Sm3 oil is the published final figure for Volve.
